method: Actual eight-island production game. Each centre/NPC initialization restores the original device orbit and player position, then idles5s. Same input recipe before/after. Left120px then right240px is one touch pointer; UI.poll drives the production camera, no direct native lens positioning. Only explicit QA-hero/top use custom lenses. Fixed60Hz poses, software GPU, not hardware performance.
